neighbours.label: preposition after a discussion verb introducing where the talk happens ('discuss on the talk page', 'let us know in the comments', 'chat over drinks')
fire: If you disagree with this review, tell us why in the comments section below.
We talked about the merger over coffee last Tuesday morning.
Feel free to share your own recipe tips in the replies.
Please raise any objections on the project's discussion forum.
Let me know what you think in the comments, I read all of them.
The two founders argued about pricing over dinner at a small bistro.
You can ask the developers questions on our Discord server anytime.
Readers debated the ending of the novel on the publisher's message board.
quiet: If you disagree with this review, that is perfectly fine with us.
We bought the company's shares in early March last year.
The recipe tips are printed in the back of the cookbook.
The project's office is located on the third floor.
Let me know what time the train arrives tomorrow.
The two founders lived in a small town near the coast.
The developers put the new server rack in the basement.
The ending of the novel takes place on a stormy island.
